aboutGodNation.title: The God Nation
aboutGodNation.subtitle: Gathering, training and mobilizing citizens of the Kingdom to carry the Gospel through modern media.
aboutGodNation.who_p1: The God Nation exists to bring together citizens of the Kingdom of God and equip them spiritually and technically to become effective carriers of the Gospel of the Kingdom through modern media.
aboutGodNation.who_p2: We are building a community of trained and equipped Kingdom ambassadors who will work together to take this message to people all around the world.
aboutGodNation.who_p3: Through spiritual formation, leadership development, and practical digital media training, we prepare believers to use modern communication platforms to reach lives, spread the Gospel, and advance God’s Kingdom to the ends of the earth.
aboutGodNation.calling_p1: This work grew out of many years of personal encounters with Christ, spiritual visitations, and divine dealings with my family. Through these encounters, a clear mandate emerged: to provoke a spiritual revival in Cameroon that will spread throughout Africa and ultimately reach the nations of the world.
aboutGodNation.calling_p2: We believe that God has destined a generation of believers in Cameroon to play a significant role in spearheading this revival. Our vision is to identify, gather, teach, and prepare this generation to fulfil its part in God’s purpose.
aboutGodNation.calling_p3: We are committed to bringing this revival army together, grounding its members in the truths of the Kingdom of God, equipping them with spiritual understanding and practical skills, and mobilizing them to carry the Gospel beyond the walls of traditional church gatherings.
aboutGodNation.action_p1: We believe that modern media provides an unprecedented opportunity to reach people, influence lives, and spread the message of the Kingdom across geographical boundaries. That is why we exist: to gather, train, equip, and mobilize citizens of the Kingdom of God for the advancement of His Kingdom through modern media.
aboutGodNation.action_p2: That is why we are building our own digital community—a place where citizens of the Kingdom of God can learn, grow, connect, receive training, and prepare for effective service.
aboutGodNation.action_p3: Through our leadership training and digital media systems, we equip Kingdom ambassadors to use social media, videos, online teaching, digital books, and other modern communication tools to reach people who might never enter a church building.
aboutGodNation.action_p4: Our goal is to develop a united, spiritually grounded, and technically equipped generation. From Cameroon to Africa and to the ends of the earth, we are preparing and mobilizing them to work together and carry the Gospel of the Kingdom through modern media.
aboutGodNation.action_p5: We are not simply building a media team; we are preparing people, developing leaders, and building a united community of Kingdom ambassadors committed to taking the Gospel to the nations.
aboutGodNation.social_intro: Join us where you prefer — WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger or Facebook — and follow us on our social networks, so that we can grow together and stay in touch.
aboutGodNation.motto_lead: Go into the digital media spaces where billions gather.
aboutGodNation.motto_text: Make disciples who make disciples, thereby taking the Gospel of the Kingdom to the ends of the earth.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The God Nation ("we", "the ministry") runs The God Nation app and the website thegodnationacademy.org. This page explains in plain words what we collect, why, who can see it, who helps us run the app, and how you can have it deleted.

p: What you give us when you sign up and use the app: your name, WhatsApp number, email address, preferred language, and where you live (country, region, division, subdivision, quarter or city).
What you choose to add: a profile photo, cover photo, short bio, posts, comments, reactions, messages, voice notes, pictures and files you send, prayer requests, and your replies to friend requests.
Your training: which teachings and books you have opened or finished, bookmarks, quiz and exam results.

Payments: when you pay for a training book by Mobile Money, we keep the order, the amount, the transaction ID you send, and the screenshot you upload as proof. We never see your Mobile Money PIN, and the payment itself happens outside the app.

King's Tokens: if the ministry has started them, we keep a record of the tokens you earn for your Dominion Clinic exams, the tokens you use toward a training book, and the date and reason for each. King's Tokens are a record of study rewards inside the app. They are not money, they cannot be bought, sold, cashed out or sent to another person, and they are used only toward the ministry's own training materials.

Ad and link details: when you arrive from an advertisement or a shared link, we note which one (for example the campaign name and the website you came from, but not the full address of that page) so we can see which ads and ambassadors bring people. This is kept with your visit and your sign-up.

If you leave your name and WhatsApp number in the “Stay connected” box, or tick the boxes at sign-up, we keep your choice, the date, and the exact sentence you agreed to. We only message you on the channels you agreed to, and you can change or stop this at any time in your profile. We also count which group, channel or page you tap to join (for example WhatsApp, Telegram or Messenger). We do not see anything about you inside those apps.

Ad measurement (only if you allow it): if you tick the box at sign-up or in your profile, we may send your email address and phone number, scrambled so they cannot be read (hashed), together with the fact that you signed up, to Meta (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok and Google. They use it to tell us which ads worked, and to show our messages to you and to people like you. In this browser, tools from those companies run only after you press “Allow” in the banner, and they may set cookies. You can take back either choice at any time (in your profile, or at the bottom of this page), and ask us to delete your account.
Referrals and earnings: who invited you, who you invited, and any referral earnings and payouts.
Events: which events you said you would come to, and whether a leader marked you present, or you finished the recording linked to the event.
Technical information: whether you are online and when you were last seen, the sign-in sessions on your devices, and, if you allow notifications, a code that lets your phone receive alerts from us.
To run the community: let you sign in, place you in your assembly, show you your leaders and fellow members, and let you chat, post and pray together.
To run the training: save your progress, mark quizzes, and confirm book payments.
To keep the app safe: prevent abuse, handle reports, and keep a record of important actions by leaders and administrators.

To contact you: send sign-in codes and notices by email, and alerts about messages, events and payments on your phone if you allow them. If you start joining and do not finish, we may send you up to three reminder emails to help you finish. If you agreed to updates by email and have been away for a while, we may send a “we miss you” email; every such email has a link to stop them, and you can change your choice at any time in your profile.

We do not sell your information. We do not show advertisements inside the app. Tools from advertising platforms (Meta, TikTok, Google) run only if you allow them, as described in section 1; without your “Allow”, the app uses no advertising or analytics trackers.
Other members and leaders can see what you choose to make visible on your profile and in the places you post, such as your name, photo, bio and your assembly.

The leaders of your assembly, and the central administrators of the ministry, can see your member details so they can care for you and manage the community. Only leaders and administrators can see the attendance sheet of an event.
Payment representatives, who are people the ministry has appointed, can see an order you open with them: your name, the amount, and the transaction ID and screenshot you send.
Your King's Tokens balance and history are seen by you and by the central administration. Leaders and other members cannot see them.
Messages sent in a chat can be seen by the people in that chat. We ask leaders and administrators to use member information only for the work of the ministry.
Follow-up conversations between a leader and a member may be reviewed by the central administration for care and quality.

If you give, we keep the amount, the date, the transaction ID you give us and the assembly you belong to. Gifts are seen only by the central administration; leaders and other members never see who gave. A help-one-another campaign publishes the names and amounts of its givers, unless you choose to appear as Anonymous.

sections.h: 4. Who helps us run the app
p: We use trusted services to run the app. They process data for us and may not use it for their own purposes.

Render hosts the app and its database (in Frankfurt, Germany). Cloudflare R2 stores uploaded files such as photos, voice notes and documents. Resend sends our emails. Your phone's own push service (Google or Apple, depending on your phone) delivers alerts.

Google Gemini is used to translate between English and French and to help draft quiz questions. It receives the text of posts and group chat messages, the audio of group chat voice notes, and teaching texts. It never receives private messages or prayer requests.

sections.h: 5. Cookies and storage on your device
p: We use a sign-in cookie so that you stay signed in, a security cookie that protects forms, and your device's local storage to remember choices such as your language and to make some content available offline. We do not use advertising cookies.
We keep your information while your account is open. Sign-in sessions on a device end after a period of inactivity.
Some records, such as payment amounts and dates, are kept for the ministry's accounts even after an account is deleted, without your name.

sections.h: 7. Your choices and deleting your account
p: You can change your profile at any time in the app, and you can turn notifications off in your phone's settings.

You can ask us to delete your account in the app (Me → Edit profile → Delete my account), or on the web page https://thegodnationacademy.org/delete-account. Your account is hidden at once. If you change your mind within 30 days, signing in again cancels the deletion. After that, an administrator approves the deletion and your profile, photos, posts, friends, group membership, exam results and sign-in are removed.
Messages you sent in other people's chats stay in those chats, shown as "This message was deleted".
You may also ask us what we hold about you, or ask us to correct it, through the contact page.

The app is meant for adults and young people who can use it with their parents' or guardians' permission. If you believe a child has joined without permission, contact us and we will remove the account.
If we change how we handle your information, we will update this page and its date. For important changes, we will tell you in the app.
For any question about your privacy, or to ask us to delete your information, write to contact@thegodnationacademy.org or use our contact page.
